root_idea.summary: A made material object fashioned for worship, especially an idol or image.
root_idea.development: The concrete sense of a manufactured worshipped object is extended in Quran-focused interpretation to anything that diverts a person from God.

senses.definition: A fabricated idol: a material object or image made from substances such as wood, stone, silver, copper, or other metal and worshipped.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural أَصْنَام refers to concrete objects of idolatrous worship. Classical descriptions differ over the precise material or form of an idol.

senses.definition: Anything that diverts a person from God or occupies the person in place of devotion to Him.
senses.usage_conditions: An explicitly reported figurative interpretation of the idols in Abraham's prayer at 14:35; this extends the term beyond physical statues and does not replace the concrete idol sense in other passages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To form, fashion, figure, shape, sculpt, or picture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II verb; its verbal noun is تَصْنِيمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quill or shaft of a feather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the shaft of any feather.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form II meaning of fashioning or shaping.

cautions: Classical authorities give differing criteria for distinguishing صَنَمٌ from وَثَنٌ, including material, shape, and corporeality; the concrete idol sense states their shared lexical core.
